Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 30.11.2023 failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 15.01.2024.
4.
In the meantime, the order dated 20.03.2017 passed by the learned SDJM, Bhagalpur in Complaint Case No. 1237 of 2016 whereby cognizance of offences under Sections 323 and Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.47776 of 2017(2) dt.10-11-2023 498A of the IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.
5. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is the husband of the O.P. No. 2.

It is further submitted that the petitioner and the O.P. No. 2 had filed Matrimonial Divorce Case No.
